A type of '''starship''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. At least one such starship was present in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] as part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet's]] [[Fourth Division]] following the [[Battle of Hoth]].

==Characteristics==
The class of [[starship]] was an asymmetrical spacecraft that was capable of [[Realspace|space]] travel, with the use of at least one [[sublight engine]] on its port side. It was characterized by a boxed [[hull]] that featured several modular sections, as well as a large dorsal fin,<ref name="Star Wars 7" /> although the fin could be absent from other vessels.<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==History==
The starship was active during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire]], serving within the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]. Following the [[Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three]], at least two such starships were part of the Alliance [[Fourth Division]], a [[Navy|naval]] [[division]] that was established after the [[Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="Star Wars 7" /> although one featured the large dorsal fin while the second did not.<ref name="Episode V" />

The two ships remained with the division as [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] departed from the ''[[Redemption]]'' aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to begin their [[rescue of Han Solo]].<ref name="Episode V" /> At least one ship with the fin attached was then subsequently was located in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] along with the rest of the division when they received a transmission from the [[Seventh Division]] for reinforcements.<ref name="Star Wars 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified_Rebel_ship_ESB.png|thumb|right|180px|The starship, as seen ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' in the background of a shot of the Rebel fleet.]]
The starship debuted, albeit unidentified, in the [[1980]] [[Star Wars saga|saga film]] [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as a background ship.<ref name="Episode V" /> The ship was prominently featured in one panel of [[Star Wars (2020) 7|''Star Wars'' (2020) 7]], which outlined more physical characteristics of the craft.<ref name="Star Wars 7" />
